name: Argent Industrial Limited
summary: Argent Industrial Limited manufactures and trades in steel and steel-related products worldwide. The company trades in sections, tube, sheet, coil, and plate steel products; offers slitting, blanking, cutting-to-length, tube, and lipped channel services, as well as flame, plasma, and laser cutting, guillotining, and bending services; distributes aluminum products; and manufactures braais and fireplaces, residential and industrial security products, pool fencing, school furniture, and roller-shutter and sectional-overhead doors, as well as metro doors for substations, driveway gates, balustrades, and stair cases. It also manufactures ladders and scaffolding, castors, wheels, and storage bins; mounties, trolleys, and other mobile access systems; aluminum structures; curtain trucks; decorative and industrial paint and coatings; steel coatings, varnishes, road marking paints, mine mark sprays, and urethane coatings; desks, cupboards, lockers, racking, school desks, beds, etc.; and shelving and racking systems. In addition, the company offers steel products, such as gates, pellets, security products, palisade fencing, sanitation structures, cell phone mast fencing, mezzanine structures, and mass carport; scrapers and pneumatic chutes, blades, grizzley frames and segments, H-frames, holding down brackets, and other mining equipment; dampening and suspension systems, and rubber and polyurethane screen panels; overhead cranes, hoists, and mechanical lifting equipment; railway and automotive products; and automotive powder coating and e-coating. Further, it provides speed control retarder systems; iron and solid wooden gates; railing and fencing products; and tinting systems, color card stands, etc. services. Additionally, the company supplies running boards and roof racks, overhead doors, sectional garage doors, high speed doors, and spare parts; and ready concrete products. Argent Industrial Limited was founded in 1972 and is based in La Lucia, South Africa.
